summary: Dell Alienware M15 R6 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Severe stuttering and performance issues during gaming, accompanied by thermal throttling, audio jack failure, and Wi-Fi speed degradation
suggested_solution: Perform a thorough system cleaning and cooling system maintenance to ensure proper airflow and heat dissipation.
Check for driver updates and install the latest versions of NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 drivers and Intel Core i7-11800H drivers.
Investigate potential tweaks or settings adjustments to optimize power management, background processes, and other system configurations.
